lines.text: He's salty because I won the card game.

data.define: Used when someone is upset or bitter, often after losing.

example.text: He's salty because I won the card game.

misuse.text: Don't call your teacher 'salty' for giving homework.

data.l1_ex: Está "salty" porque gané al juego de cartas.

native.tip: “salty” = amargado; resentido; molesto. Ejemplo: “He's salty because I won the card game.”
native.caption:
¿Qué significa “salty”?
“salty” = amargado; resentido; molesto.
Ejemplo: “He's salty because I won the card game.” (Está "salty" porque gané al juego de cartas.)
